tagline: A cognitive architecture and an open evidence trail for building alignment into how an agent thinks, not bolting it on afterwards.
what_is_ree: REE (Reflective-Ethical Engine) is a research programme. Its bet is that alignment should live inside the generative machinery of agency -- in how an agent attributes self versus world, models harm, forms and keeps commitments, carries the residue of its past actions, and exercises care -- rather than being scored on after the fact. REE is built and tested as a claim-governed system: every idea becomes an explicit claim, claims are turned into experiments, experiments produce evidence, the evidence is reviewed, and governance updates each claim's standing. This page is a read-only window onto that trail.
what_v3_proves: V3 is the current working substrate (internally tagged "ree_hybrid_guardrails_v1"). It is where claims about memory, harm modelling, commitment, self/world attribution and related mechanisms are put to an experimental test. V3 is NOT a finished product or a claim that the architecture "works": it is an apparatus for finding out which mechanisms hold up and which do not. Many results weaken claims or leave them unresolved -- that is the point of the exercise.
what_v3_does_not_prove: Nothing here should be read as a deployable safe-AI system, a guarantee of safety, or a settled scientific result. Reviewed PASS evidence on a narrow experimental substrate is a small, local signal -- not proof that a mechanism generalises. Weakened and unresolved claims are shown alongside supported ones precisely so the picture stays honest.
how_to_read_evidence: Each claim shows the direction of its reviewed evidence: supported, weakened, mixed, unresolved, or superseded. "Supported" means at least one reviewed experiment passed its pre-registered criteria; it does not mean proven. Experiments that were superseded by a corrected re-run, or that hit a vacuous test criterion, are excluded from scoring and labelled as such. Pending (not-yet-reviewed) results are shown only as a count -- never as a list -- so the page reflects reviewed evidence, not work in progress.
not_yet_inferred: That a supported claim generalises beyond its narrow experimental substrate.
That the absence of a claim here means REE rejects the idea -- future-stage and unsettled claims are withheld by design.
That weakened or unresolved claims are dead ends; many are awaiting a richer substrate.
Any timeline, roadmap ordering, or what will be tested next -- that is deliberately not published.
